errors.evidence: The description states the chart has four sectors, but there are clearly five sectors shown in the figure: 'Да, напълно' (17%), 'Не мога да преценя' (35%), 'Не, изобщо' (4%), 'По-скоро да' (35%), and 'По-скоро не' (9%).
The description states that the two 35% sectors ('По-скоро да' and 'Не мога да преценя') are located opposite each other. Visually, these two sectors (yellow and orange) are adjacent, not opposite.
